_comment: Order partials that no route can reach, with the reason. The sweep cannot cover these; ScrollSweepCoverageTest requires each to be declared here rather than silently skipped.

reasons.hunter: award_id 6969 is Arcanyst's invention and is not an ORK award id — system/lib/ork3/data/scroll-orders.php says so in as many words. No ork_kingdomaward row can resolve to it (verified against kingdom 1, which carries all sixteen other orders), so Scrollery/compose and Scrollery/render can never select hunter.tpl as an ORDER. hunter/border.png IS live as a custom-recipe border and stage C sweeps it.
